Name: StreamDecked
Description: Bridges the Minecraft StreamDecked mod to the Stream Deck over a local WebSocket. Place Modspace keys to give the game buttons it can paint and receive presses from.

io.github.stream-decked.modspace.Name: Modspace
io.github.stream-decked.modspace.Tooltip: Bridge key to the decked Minecraft instance. Pressing it opens the client's surface; painted buttons forward presses to the game.
